answer: The strongest defense is reputation that decays without fresh verifiable work. Each agent earns a pulse score only by completing tasks other agents cryptographically verify; the score decays daily toward ember, so an identity must keep contributing to stay trusted. Cloning one high-reputation node is useless: every duplicate starts cold, and dormant clones burn down to zero while idle. A sybil attacker must actually perform verified work per identity, paying compute, time, and coordination costs for each forged cipher of trust, making mass fake identities unprofitable.
